contract.title: TWIN-43 AP/VMware 921600 波特率统一与全栈一键编译及配置化启动脚本

dependency_conditions.required: 继承TWIN-04 VMware运行时构建与services_manifest.json配置基线
继承TWIN-30 VMware全流程闭环与串口通信基线

contract.checkpoint: 开工前绑定；组件自检；独立沙箱与QA审查；收件

steps: git -C soc-ap checkout -- core/forward/transport/serial_posix.h core/forward/transport/serial_posix.cpp core/host/ config/runtime/ dist/vmware_twin/config/ tools/deploy_twin.sh

commands.expected: sim模式下dbus/forward/device_manager/ui-gateway全栈启动成功，--status探活HTTP 200，--stop优雅退出无残留进程

positive_cases: serial_posix.cpp中baud_to_speed支持921600(B921600)与460800(B460800)，且保留115200等既有波特率支持
SerialConfig与QueryOptions默认波特率统一为921600，services_manifest.json中ap_mc_uart.baud_rate统一为921600
deploy_twin.sh无参读取config/runtime/vmware/aisoc_twin.conf，支持--build-only、--mode sim|hardware、--config、--status、--stop，并在hardware模式下向forward_service_daemon传递--port与--baud 921600
negative_cases: 传入非法波特率（如123456）时baud_to_speed与parse_baud_rate立即返回false并拒绝打开串口
hardware模式下当指定AISOC_UART_DEVICE不存在时，deploy_twin.sh明确报错并以非0退出码终止，不静默降级为sim模式

import sys,urllib.request,urllib.error
u=[a for a in sys.argv[1:] if a.startswith(\x27http\x27)][-1]
w=\x27-w\x27 in sys.argv
try:
 r=urllib.request.urlopen(u,timeout=2);b=r.read();sys.stdout.write(str(r.status)) if w else sys.stdout.buffer.write(b)
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
 sys.stdout.write(str(e.code)) if w else None;sys.exit(0 if w else 22)
except Exception:
 sys.stdout.write(\x27000\x27) if w else None;sys.exit(7)
"); p.chmod(0o755)" && export PATH="/tmp/qa_twin43/bin:$PATH" && ([ -d /tmp/qa_twin43/soc-ap ] || (cp -r ../soc-ap /tmp/qa_twin43/ && rm -rf /tmp/qa_twin43/soc-ap/build && ([ -e /tmp/qa_twin43/soc-ap/third_party/install ] || (mkdir -p /tmp/qa_twin43/soc-ap/third_party && ln -s /usr/local /tmp/qa_twin43/soc-ap/third_party/install)))) && cd /tmp/qa_twin43/soc-ap && bash tools/deploy_twin.sh --mode sim --port 18080 && bash tools/deploy_twin.sh --status --port 18080 && bash tools/deploy_twin.sh --stop --port 18080 && rm -rf /tmp/qa_twin43
